 Mortgage and refinance interest rates today, Sunday, November 15, 2026: 5/1 ARM rates up over 70 basis points since last week
 Tim Manni · Sun, November 15, 2026 at 3:00 AM PST 4 min read Compared with last week, adjustable  mortgage rates  are up over 70 basis points, according to Zillow rate data provided to Yahoo Finance. 
 The 30-year fixed purchase rate today,  Sunday, November 15, 2026 , rose 41 basis points to  7.27% since last week ;  the 15-year fixed purchase rate rose 43 basis points to  6.62% ;   and the 5/1 ARM purchase rate rose by 72 basis points to  7.45% . 
 The 30-year refinance rate rose 29 basis points from last week to  7.17% , the 15-year refi rate rose by 33 basis points to  6.68%,  and the 5/1 ARM refi rate rose 82 basis points to 7.43% .

 Your mortgage rate plays a large role in how much your monthly payment will be. Use this mortgage calculator to see how your mortgage amount, rate, and term length will impact your monthly payments.

The amount you pay as a down payment can influence your mortgage interest rate. Generally, larger down payments result in lower interest rates, as lenders see these as a sign of strong financial commitment.  How to get a low mortgage rate 
 The best mortgage lenders typically offer the lowest mortgage rates to borrowers with larger down payments, excellent credit scores, and low debt-to-income ratios. So, if you want a lower rate, try saving more, improving your credit score , or paying down some debt before you start shopping for homes. 
 Waiting for rates to drop probably isn't the best method to get the lowest mortgage rate right now. If you're ready to buy, focusing on your personal finances is probably the best way to lower your rate. 
 How to choose a mortgage lender 
 To find the best mortgage lender for your situation, apply for mortgage preapproval with three or four companies. Be sure to apply to all of them within a short time frame — this will give you the most accurate comparisons and have less impact on your credit score. 
 When choosing a lender, don't just compare interest rates. Look at the mortgage annual percentage rate (APR) — this includes the interest rate, any discount points, and fees. The APR, which is also expressed as a percentage, reflects the true annual cost of borrowing money. This is probably the most important number to look at when comparing mortgage lenders. 
 Read more: Learn 6 tips for choosing a mortgage lender 
 Mortgage rates today, Sunday, November 15, 2026. Current mortgage rates: FAQs 
 Are mortgage rates expected to rise or fall the rest of this year? 
 According to the latest Mortgage Bankers Association (MBA) forecast, the 30-year fixed purchase rate will average 7.3% for the fourth quarter of 2026. Fannie Mae's forecast puts the 30-year rate at an average of 7.4%. 
 Will mortgage rates rise or fall in 2027? 
 According to the same two forecasts, the MBA expects the 30-year average rate to range from 7.1% to 7.2%, and Fannie Mae predicts an average 30-year rate of 7.5%. 
 How do I get the lowest refinance rate? 
 In many ways, securing a low mortgage refinance rate is similar to buying your home. Try to improve your credit score and lower your debt-to-income ratio (DTI) . Refinancing into a shorter term will also land you a lower rate, though your monthly mortgage payments will be higher. 
 Methodology 
 The interest rates provided by the Zillow Lender Marketplace are national averages rounded to the nearest hundredth. The rates featured in today's daily rate article were provided to Yahoo Finance the previous day. The rates in this article are current as of November 13, 2026, at 12:03 p.m. ET.
